title: Best Car Rental Deals: Avis Direct-Prepaid Cancellation Costs
answer: For Avis.com direct-prepaid reservations, cancellation at least 24 hours before pickup carries a $50 processing fee, and cancellation within 24 hours carries a $150 processing fee. If you do not cancel before pickup and do not collect the car on the rental date, none of the prepaid amount is refunded.
html:
Keep the cancellation cost with the original booking

The cancellation amounts above apply to Avis.com direct-prepaid reservations. They are not a rule for another company, an intermediary booking or every type of Avis reservation.

A cheaper quote and an existing prepaid booking

A lower replacement quote does not erase the original prepaid reservation’s cancellation terms. Keep that reservation’s cancellation window and the applicable processing fee alongside the replacement quote before deciding whether to cancel.

Not cancelling and not collecting the car

If you do not cancel before pickup and do not collect the car on the rental date, none of the prepaid amount is refunded.

This no-refund condition is different from cancelling within a stated window. Do not treat a no-show as a free cancellation.
